rules.name: cs-09-bfa-leg-prices-premium-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT 'current' AS legacy_table, count(*) AS row_count FROM dbsystemuat.security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'historical', count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate
SELECT security_id, settle_price FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate
SELECT security_id, settle_price FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate

SELECT coalesce(updated_by, created_by) AS written_by, date_trunc('minute', coalesce(updated_timestamp, created_timestamp)) AS written_at, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, d.security_id, d.premium, a.active_lots, h.settle_price FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs d JOIN dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a ON a.trade_id = d.trade_id AND a.value_date = :valueDate LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs h ON h.security_id = d.security_id AND h.value_date = :valueDate WHERE d.contract_number LIKE 'BFA_CT%' AND a.active_lots != 0

SELECT c.trade_id, c.contract_number, d.security_id, c.traded_price AS premium, c.active_lots, c.settle_price FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c JOIN opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.business_unit = c.business_unit AND d.trade_id = c.trade_id AND d.is_latest_version = 1 WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.contract_number LIKE 'BFA_CT%'

SELECT table_name, data_type, numeric_precision, numeric_scale FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'opera' AND table_name IN ('deal_ticket_table', 'cloned_deal_ticket_table') AND column_name = 'premium'

SELECT c.trade_id, c.contract_number, c.traded_price AS cache_premium, d.premium AS clone_premium, (SELECT max(t.premium) FROM opera.deal_ticket_table t WHERE t.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND t.trade_id = c.trade_id AND t.is_latest_version = 1) AS deal_premium, (SELECT count(DISTINCT t.premium) FROM opera.deal_ticket_table t WHERE t.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND t.trade_id = c.trade_id AND t.is_latest_version = 1) AS deal_latest_prices, c.active_lots, c.settle_price, c.mult_factor, c.nc_factor, c.fx_nc_factor, c.mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c JOIN opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.business_unit = c.business_unit AND d.trade_id = c.trade_id AND d.is_latest_version = 1 WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.contract_number LIKE 'BFA_CT%' ORDER BY c.contract_number, c.trade_id
